summary: Build practical skills in gender data, pay-gap review, and fair workplace processes. Explore the five-day course and its applied exercises.
lede: Gender diversity training helps HR professionals, people leaders, and inclusion specialists identify gender-based barriers across workplace practices. Participants work with gender-disaggregated data to examine representation and pay gaps, review recruitment and career progression for barriers, and consider workplace safety; they also practise using Excel to analyze workforce patterns and drafting action plans with measurable indicators.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course is designed for professionals who influence gender equality through HR processes, workplace policies, people analytics, employee experience, or organizational reporting.
modules: Gender Data and Pay Gap Analysis
ILO Conventions and Equal Pay Practices
Gender Equality Action Plans and Reporting
prerequisites: Working knowledge of HR processes, people management, workforce reporting, or workplace policy is recommended. No coding or specialist analytics background is required. Advanced topics such as AI-assisted recruitment are introduced at operational awareness level; the course does not teach model development or deployment.
